title: Dental PPO Plans Market Availability and Enrollment Windows
content:
Which markets may buy each of the Dental PPO Plans, and the enrollment, cancellation and reinstatement windows that apply to it.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Individual market | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Individual exchange | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No |
| Employer group | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Exchange-filed | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | No |
| Minimum enrolled lives for a group | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 5 | 10 |
| Minimum enrollee age (years) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Free-look period (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Binder deadline (calendar days after coverage effective date) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Reinstatement window (calendar days after termination) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Re-enrollment lockout (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 24 | 24 |
| Group special enrollment window (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Group special enrollment window after loss of Medicaid or CHIP (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

- **Free-look period:** calendar days after the coverage effective date during which an individual or individual exchange subscriber may return the policy for a full premium refund.
- **Binder deadline:** calendar days after the coverage effective date by which the binder premium must be received before the application is cancelled.
- **Reinstatement window:** calendar days after the termination date within which coverage ended for nonpayment may be reinstated.
- **Re-enrollment lockout:** calendar months after a voluntary termination date during which the same person may not re-enroll in any Cascade individual-market dental PPO plan.
- **Special enrollment windows:** calendar days after a qualifying event (marriage, birth, adoption, loss of other coverage) within which a group special enrollment must be requested, or after loss of Medicaid or CHIP coverage.

Elite 2500 is sold to employer groups only, and only the exchange-filed plans (Value 1000 and Plus 1500) may be sold on the individual exchange.
